principle: A module must represent a mechanism cluster owned primarily by one core. Upstream causes, generic context moderators, and cross-core connector constructs are not duplicated as modules.

dispositions.reason: Valence and arousal are separable dimensions but belong in one dimensional-affect mechanism cluster at L1; they can remain separate L2 neurons.
Identity signaling/self-presentation is retained as a transmission motive; identity states connect to it through cross-core edges rather than duplicate modules.
Homophily/similarity can influence identity, trust and connection but is not itself social identity.
Reciprocity distinguishes parasocial from reciprocal relationships and is a relationship-topology context/boundary, not a connection module.
Keep only transmission-specific emotion-regulation motives; upstream arousal/emotion remains in Valuation & Emotion and connects via edges.
Audience, modality, channel and device are moderators/context dimensions, not psychological transmission mechanisms.
Prediction error/value updating is a lower-level mechanism inside reinforcement/outcome learning rather than a separate L1 module.
Social bonding/relationship maintenance is a distinct transmission motive supported by the communication review and was missing in Cycle 01.

migration_rule: Deprecated/moved module IDs remain in provenance and must never be silently reused for a different construct.
